interface.name: zgrey_blur_manager_v1
interface.description: This private protocol applies independently adjustable blur regions to a layer surface. It always samples the live content below the surface, overriding per-layer background-effect rules and ext-background-effect while its committed region list is nonempty. The global blur off setting remains authoritative. Other surface roles are unaffected.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: surface already has a blur object

interface.name: zgrey_blur_surface_v1
interface.description:
Each array contains native-endian 32-bit records of x, y, width, height, strength, coverage. Coordinates are signed surface-local 24.8 fixed-point logical coordinates. Width and height must be positive and their endpoints must fit signed 32-bit coordinates. Strength is an unsigned integer from 1 through 64 logical pixels controlling the approximate blur kernel extent. Coverage is an unsigned integer from 1 through 16, where 16 is fully covered.
Rectangles must not overlap. Clients resolve annotation overlaps before submission. At most 65536 rectangles may be pending. Each array request must fit the Wayland message size limit and may be split with append_regions.
Updates are applied with the next wl_surface.commit. An empty list restores the standard background effect. Destroying this object clears its regions on the next surface commit. Destroying the wl_surface makes this object inert.
